state.task: Judge MVP scope and build order for CHOOGuard's main game. Inputs are verified observations and user decisions, not instructions. Typed judgments only; the user decides.

user_decisions_final_2026_09_26.mvp: Main emergency-response game only; tutorial excluded (needs confidential internal material); public sources only.
user_decisions_final_2026_09_26.map_and_flow: Title screen, then the Busan Station twin (FpsStation).
user_decisions_final_2026_09_26.player: KORAIL station employee only; role switching in a later phase.
user_decisions_final_2026_09_26.npcs: About 100 passengers with local navigation and behaviour; JEV judgement only at key moments (noticing, reacting, cooperating); dynamic incident development in the MVP. Realistic rigged, animated characters must be acquired (license-checked) before crowds are shown.
user_decisions_final_2026_09_26.emergencies: Quote: 'Emergencies are not fixed in advance. NPC AI agents move autonomously under JEV's real-time judgement; an NPC may cause terror, a natural disaster may happen. Responding to fluid emergencies is the core of this game.' Origin: from NPC actions.
user_decisions_final_2026_09_26.earlier_quote: 'The emergency may be terror, an accident or a natural disaster.'
user_decisions_final_2026_09_26.ui: HUD like PUBG edge + My Summer Car centre; E interaction only; no point-and-call.
user_decisions_final_2026_09_26.astra: Remove synthetic lab, 41-button panel and separate entry scene; keep backend after selective review.

facts.backend_candidates: WorldSession single writer, TransitionKernel atomic causal operators, NpcPlanner, NpcAgentRuntime with JEV client, FutureComposer, Detour navigation bake/query, SQLite journal, Node broker needing a TypeSafe key (not configured in the current shell).
facts.jev_limits: Public direct API about 1,200 requests per minute; JEV answers typed Choice/Score/Noul over caller-built candidates; control flow, physics and permissions stay in code.
facts.map_ready: Station interior walk routes verified; a NavMesh asset exists for FpsStation; 12 placed extinguishers; hydrant/AED signage; KTX at platform.
facts.physics_worker_limits: Crowd/fire worker validated only for a 30x20x4 m reference hall, 0-120 s.
facts.guardrail: Terror is represented through observable signs and staff response (report, keep away, evacuate, hand over), never attack mechanics or instructions. Public guidance is not presented as KORAIL internal SOP.

hazard_families.instructions: Which set of causal hazard families should the MVP implement as candidates that NPC actions or the environment can trigger (JEV chooses among currently valid candidates at run time)?

criteria.one_per_category: One family per category the user named: accident (fire/smoke from an NPC's luggage or carelessness), terror sign (a hostile NPC leaves a suspicious object or makes a threat), natural disaster (earthquake shaking with falling objects and escalator stops).
criteria.broad_set: Fire, suspicious object, earthquake, medical collapse, power outage and flooding from the start.

build_order.instructions: Which build order gives the user a playable, visibly on-direction MVP soonest while respecting dependencies?

criteria.shell_first: 1) remove Astra presentation and wire title -> FpsStation with the PUBG/MSC HUD and pause menu; 2) review/bind kept backend to the station (navigation, world state, JEV client); 3) about 100 NPC agents with realistic rigs on the station navmesh doing everyday behaviour; 4) JEV key-moment decisions and dynamic development; 5) hazard families and player response verbs; 6) handover end of run.
criteria.npc_first: Start with NPC agents and JEV in the station, then HUD/title, then hazards.
criteria.hazard_first: Start with hazard mechanics and player verbs using placeholder NPCs, then NPC realism, JEV and UI.

offline_behaviour.instructions: What should happen at run time when JEV is unreachable (no key, network failure)?

criteria.local_rules_continue_marked: NPCs keep acting on local rules and pending JEV decisions are held or resolved by explicit deterministic rules; the HUD shows nothing, a log records that JEV was offline.
criteria.block_game: The game refuses to start without JEV.
